title: Re-enchant perk
summary: A new Crafter perk. Enchanted items and books can go back on the enchanting table and keep what they already have. Each item can be re-enchanted a limited number of times, shown in its tooltip, and more points raise the limit. Re-enchanting costs more levels than a fresh enchant, and the table shows both prices. A row with nothing new to add says so and can't be picked.
